<div class="main-about">

## About Me

Thank you for visiting my website!

I am a Statistical Scientist and Ph.D. student in Biostatistics at [The Ohio State University](https://www.osu.edu/), with a background in statistics, mathematics, and data-driven approaches to scientific research.

I earned my M.S. in Statistics from the [University of New Mexico](https://www.unm.edu/) and my B.Sc. double major in Mathematics and Statistics from the [University of Ghana](https://www.ug.edu.gh/). My academic journey reflects a commitment to applying statistical thinking and rigorous methodology to generate meaningful insights and support evidence-based decision-making.

*Outside of my research, I engage in professional service through ASA and ENAR initiatives, support underrepresented high school and college students, enjoy connecting with nature, cooking authentic Ghanaian cuisine, participating in football, and pursuing hands-on craftsmanship, including making leather sandals and building wooden furniture.*
